items.summary: CFO recommendation: retain containment-only execution and authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization, queue expansion, requeues, or production work. AI spend was $963.569 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 across 5,390 calls, with 232 errors and 5 transient errors. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; named site rows show $0 commission, so site revenue claims, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. Continue only existing reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, and bounded security-evidence work.

Attribution and margin remain unresolved. The $4.92 is an aggregate provider row and cannot be assigned to a site without inventing attribution. Contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are absent. Minimum measurement: a period-aligned site/fleet cost ledger matched to attributable commission. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level cost and incremental attributable outcomes are unavailable. Minimum measurement: per-experiment cost plus pre/post or control-based incremental site-attributed commission or conversion outcome.

Budget exposure is unbounded: monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality threshold are blank in the brief. Infrastructure spend is unknown because no infrastructure-cost source is present; do not infer it from AI spend. Minimum measurement: owner-approved limits for each field and an actual-versus-budget report. Preserve impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, social coverage, AI calls, and technical scores as operating metrics, not financial returns.

Retain the existing workstreams only: reconcile execution records, contain failed runs without requeue, record scheduled measurement from existing source-dated telemetry, and continue bounded security evidence. Keep the gated product private pending owner and required human-review decisions. No new proposal or change request is financially justified on the current evidence.
